mapper.sql: FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id JOIN customer c ON c.customer_id = fs.customer_id
mapper.select:
SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt, fs.customer_id AS customerId, c.display_name AS displayName, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, fs.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion
ORDER BY pr.predicted_at
ASC DESC
, pr.prediction_id
ASC DESC
LIMIT #{condition.size} OFFSET #{condition.offset}

SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, fs.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.cumulative_risk_3m AS cumulativeRisk3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, pr.percentile, CAST(pr.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, pr.explanation, pr.recommendation, CAST(pr.llm_output AS CHAR) AS llmOutput, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id WHERE pr.prediction_id = #{predictionId}

SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, fs.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.cumulative_risk_3m AS cumulativeRisk3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, pr.percentile, CAST(pr.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, pr.explanation, pr.recommendation, CAST(pr.llm_output AS CHAR) AS llmOutput, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id WHERE fs.customer_id = #{customerId} AND fs.base_ym = #{baseYm} AND pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} ORDER BY pr.predicted_at DESC, pr.prediction_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT feature_snapshot_id AS featureSnapshotId, customer_id AS customerId, base_ym AS baseYm, feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, CAST(features AS CHAR) AS features FROM feature_snapshot WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND base_ym IN (#{baseYm}, #{previousBaseYm}) ORDER BY base_ym DESC

SELECT pr.prediction_id AS predictionId, fs.customer_id AS customerId, fs.base_ym AS baseYm, pr.model_version AS modelVersion, fs.feature_schema_version AS featureSchemaVersion, pr.hazard_1m AS hazard1m, pr.hazard_2m AS hazard2m, pr.hazard_3m AS hazard3m, pr.cumulative_risk_3m AS cumulativeRisk3m, pr.risk_grade AS riskGrade, CASE pr.risk_grade WHEN 'NORMAL' THEN '정상' WHEN 'INTEREST' THEN '관심' WHEN 'CAUTION' THEN '주의' WHEN 'WARNING' THEN '경고' END AS riskGradeName, pr.percentile, CAST(pr.reasons AS CHAR) AS reasons, pr.explanation, pr.recommendation, CAST(pr.llm_output AS CHAR) AS llmOutput, pr.llm_status AS llmStatus, pr.prompt_version AS promptVersion, pr.predicted_at AS predictedAt FROM prediction_result pr JOIN feature_snapshot fs ON fs.feature_snapshot_id = pr.feature_snapshot_id WHERE pr.feature_snapshot_id = #{featureSnapshotId} AND pr.model_version = #{modelVersion} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prediction_result ( feature_snapshot_id, model_version, hazard_1m, hazard_2m, hazard_3m, cumulative_risk_3m, risk_grade, percentile, reasons, explanation, recommendation, llm_output, llm_status, prompt_version, predicted_at ) VALUES ( #{featureSnapshotId}, #{modelVersion}, #{hazard1m}, #{hazard2m}, #{hazard3m}, #{cumulativeRisk3m}, #{riskGrade}, #{percentile}, CAST(#{reasons} AS JSON), #{explanation}, #{recommendation}, CAST(#{llmOutput} AS JSON), #{llmStatus}, #{promptVersion}, #{predictedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE prediction_result SET hazard_1m = #{hazard1m}, hazard_2m = #{hazard2m}, hazard_3m = #{hazard3m}, cumulative_risk_3m = #{cumulativeRisk3m}, risk_grade = #{riskGrade}, percentile = #{percentile}, reasons = CAST(#{reasons} AS JSON), explanation = #{explanation}, recommendation = #{recommendation}, llm_output = CAST(#{llmOutput} AS JSON), llm_status = #{llmStatus}, prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, predicted_at = #{predictedAt} WHERE prediction_id = #{predictionId} AND (llm_status != 'COMPLETED' OR explanation IS NULL OR explanation = '' OR prompt_version IS NULL OR prompt_version != #{promptVersion})
